source: Next.js App Router streaming RSC chunks (self.__next_f.push)
payload_type: text/javascript (inline script streaming RSC JSON state)
notes: Paris uses Next.js App Router with streaming React Server Components (RSC) embedded in self.__next_f.push calls. The commercial facets (tipoProductoAll) are present inside chunk 285 in generalFacets. Products can be navigated deterministically using the URL query parameter ?tipoProductoAll={category} appended to the brand search URL, or via brand store /mujer/marcas/{brand}/. The Mega Menu is an uncollapsed DOM component that must be isolated/ignored.
